title: Listen claim carries each segment's section and kind
reason: The runner claim gives segments as {text} only, so the Mac runner guesses section changes from heading-like lines to place its longer pauses; listen_parts.segments already stores section, block and kind. The runner already prefers a section field when present (is_section_start).
